question:
**Select the most appropriate one-word substitution of the given group of words.**

A person engaged in or trained for spaceflight.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Astronaut**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct answer is: **Astronaut** (अंतरिक्ष यात्री) - a person engaged in or trained for spaceflight.
 
• Explanation: 
 
 
• **Astute** (तीक्ष्ण) means having or showing an ability to accurately assess situations or people and turn this to one's advantage.
 
• **Astronomer** (खगोलविद्) means a scientist who studies celestial bodies such as stars, planets, and galaxies.
 
• **Astronaut** (अंतरिक्ष यात्री) refers to a person who is trained for spaceflight or who travels in space.
 
• **Atrocious** (अत्यंत घोर) means horrifyingly wicked or cruel; extremely bad or unpleasant. 
 
 
 
• In the context of the sentence, we are referring to a person who is trained for spaceflight, so the correct answer is "**astronaut**."
 
• *Sentence: Neil Armstrong was a renowned **astronaut** who became the first person to walk on the moon.*
